cohort: 499 pregnant women between the ages of 18 and 40 who were more than 20 weeks gestation (based on last menstrual period) and without valve heart disease, chronic hypertension, or coagulopathies.
finding: The study found that MEWTs had a diagnostic accuracy of 90.78% for predicting maternal morbidity as determined by ICU admission within 24 hours postpartum.
